_rule: HARD CONSTRAINT: never AI-generate product bottles. Always composite a real cutout PNG from the library below. AI may only build the surrounding frame/background/text, never the product itself.

hideaway_dupe_bottles.note: ~80 real Hideaway 50ml bottle cutouts on transparent bg. Use the OURS bottle from here.

designer_references.note: Real designer-original cutouts for the THEIRS side.

scent_to_designer_map._note: Confirm with Steve. Hideaway scent name -> designer inspiration. Needed to pair OURS cutout with the correct THEIRS designer reference.

pipeline_notes.into_higgsfield: Real cutouts reach Higgsfield via the user-side upload widget (media_upload_widget) or a public/importable URL (media_import_url). Pass as generate_image medias[] with role 'image'. Prefer marketing_studio_image, which preserves the product reference.
pipeline_notes.egress: Sandbox can reach drive.google.com and upload.higgsfield.ai, but NOT Higgsfield's output CDN (cloudfront). So renders are reviewed via CDN links / Slack, not downloaded locally.

delivery.batch_on_approval: approved master (4 sizes) + 5 variations x 4 sizes = 24 files, regional copy frozen
